question: Why is this power sometimes seen as limited?
premises: only by blind views hidden by dualism
difficulty of capacity of this power
inference: The verse attributes apparent limitation to dualist blind views, not to the power itself.
uncertainties: whether kvacitsthiteḥ means occasional manifestation or occasional obstruction
plain_english: Only by blind views hidden by dualism does difficulty of capacity of this power arise, by rule of its sometimes standing.
